Dataset: Moving Annual Median Rent by Suburb and Town
Granularity: Rental area × dwelling type × reporting quarter
Comments / Caveats: Rental areas do not always align with ABS suburb boundaries. Some rental areas combine multiple suburbs, making geographical matching difficult. Rental bond data is only a proxy for rental affordability and does not capture all accommodation types.

Publisher / Source: Crime Statistics Agency Victoria – Crime Data
Granularity: Year × LGA × postcode × suburb × offence classification
Comments / Caveats: Criminal incidents represent offences reported to Victoria Police, not overall neighbourhood safety. Suburb names require standardisation before joining. Crime data from 2026 is compared against 2021 Census population, creating a time difference.

Publisher / Source: Australian Bureau of Statistics – Census DataPacks
Comments / Caveats: Census data is from 2021 and may not reflect current demographics. Small population counts may be affected by confidentiality adjustments. Language spoken at home is a proxy for cultural community, not ethnicity.

Publisher / Source: Australian Bureau of Statistics – ASGS Boundaries
Comments / Caveats: Uses 2021 ABS suburb boundaries to align with Census data. Suburb boundaries may differ from those used by other datasets. Geographic identifiers and names must be standardised before joining.

Publisher / Source: Australian Bureau of Statistics – ASGS Boundaries
Granularity: Greater Capital City Statistical Area polygon
Comments / Caveats: The Greater Melbourne statistical boundary includes some outer and semi-rural areas. It does not align exactly with postcode or LGA boundaries. Used to filter datasets to the project's geographic scope.

Vicmap may exclude informal, recently established or closed facilities. Facility classifications do not necessarily identify the cultural communities served. Replaces the Schools dataset following a 99.79% proximity match, although this does not guarantee identical records.

Publisher / Source: Department of Transport and Planning – Transport Open Data
Comments / Caveats: Transport stop counts do not necessarily indicate service frequency, accessibility or quality. Multiple stops may serve the same route. Stop locations alone cannot reliably measure journey times or transport convenience.

Publisher / Source: Geoscience Australia / National Health Services Directory – Healthcare Data
Version Used: October 2026 extract; underlying data dates vary
Comments / Caveats: Healthcare locations may not reflect recent openings or closures. Facilities vary in services, eligibility and operating hours. Geographic proximity does not guarantee availability or accessibility of healthcare services.

Dataset: Moving annual median rent by LGA
Granularity: Rental area × dwelling type × reporting quarter
Comments / Caveats: Rents by LGA are to be used for infilling where suburb rent is not recorded. This infilling will come with caveats so it is important to reflect the infilling in the UI.
